status: frozen before any test realization was simulated or encoded

solver.name: cc-fd-etdrk4
solver.scheme: ETDRK4 (Cox-Matthews; Kassam-Trefethen contour, 64 points); diffusion exact in the BC eigenbasis (rFFT / DST-II / DCT-II); advection, exchange and reactions explicit

contact_sheet.layout: 2 channel rows (u, v) x 5 time columns
contact_sheet.orientation: x to the right, y upward

gme2b.positions: sequential, as in the reference gme_inference.py

model_inputs.normalization: every embedding re-normalized in float32; full native dimension
model_inputs.precision: bfloat16 for all models (CPU with native AMX bf16); diagnostic: EmbeddingGemma 2 float32 re-encoding of realization 0 for all 54 configurations and three modes, if time permits

embedding_subset.reason: CPU-only environment (2 cores, no GPU); the full 48,600-input run is not feasible here
embedding_subset.rule: first realizations in index order; fixed before any embedding of test inputs

controls.time_order: panels reversed (index order 4,3,2,1,0) with header labels unchanged
controls.first_frame: single t=0 column sheet; one per IC family and realization, encoded twice
controls.notation: diffusion as second partials, terms reordered, coordinates renamed x->xi, y->zeta
controls.mismatch: sheet of configuration (p,f,b) with the deck of (p+1 mod 6, f, b), same realization

baselines.text: character 3-5-gram TF-IDF (sublinear tf, fitted on the analysed decks), cosine
baselines.image_pixels: rendered sheet RGB pixels, flattened, L2-normalized
baselines.image_fourier: |2D DFT| of each 64x64 field at the five frames, frequencies |k|<=8 per axis, L2-normalized
baselines.numeric_cosine: physical cosine of trajectory profiles (amplitude removed)

analysis.reference: five-frame RMS over matched realizations (primary); 100-frame RMS (secondary)
analysis.primary: within each IC family, 153 off-diagonal pairs of the 18x18 matrices: Spearman(S_emb, -D), and ordered-triplet accuracy (reference ties excluded, embedding ties = 1/2)
analysis.matched_subset: embedding and reference matrices are computed on the same realization subset; agreement with the 100-realization reference is reported separately
analysis.breakdown: triplets whose candidates share / do not share the anchor BC
analysis.separation_rule: triplet (i;j,k) resolved if |D_ik - D_ij| > 2 eps_i + eps_j + eps_k; eps from exact semidiscrete references (linear classes; certified up to roundoff) or ||fl32(X_m)-X_2m|| + 2||X_m-X_2m|| (nonlinear; convergence-checked)
